research_notes: Seek Mallesons and Telstra employment/CV records establishing individual full-time status, exact appointments and leave; investigate 2007–2008 break and education/employment overlaps before totals.

2026-09-29 initial research checked DFAT's official APH-derived chronology, member biography, 2013 ABC election profile, ACYD 2015 delegate profile and Telstra 2010 ASX prospectus. Targeted full-time and 2009-appointment searches produced no individual contract or hours evidence; similarly named overseas executives and journalists excluded.

First-speech debate page was inspected but returned multiple speakers and no useful employer match. A snippet about qualifying as a lawyer at age 31 was not attributed to Watts. DFAT's linked professional profile did not return content; no restricted material accessed.

Telstra source expressly addresses ownership/control in the employment era; public-sector clients, NBN policy responsibilities and government-relations duties do not make a commercial employee a public servant. Precise legal-employer entity and any intra-group transfer remain follow-up questions.

No four-year plus two-year calculation is made from year-only ranges without hours and transition evidence; missing public employment evidence is not a verified zero. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; blocked status retained pending substantive evidence.
